content.title: About
content.content: Flavored latte is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from espresso, milk, and natural flavorings (vanilla, caramel, nut, etc.). It combines the strength of coffee with the smooth creaminess of milk and adds a taste note that makes the drink more versatile.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Latte originated in Italy; the word “latte” means “milk”.
Flavored versions appeared in the US in the 1970s as part of the specialty coffee movement.
A typical latte contains 60‑100 mg of caffeine per serving, depending on the espresso dose.
Natural extracts are often used for flavor, though artificial flavorings are also common.
Latte is usually served in large cups (300‑350 ml), making it popular in offices.

items.title: Energizing effect
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, improving focus and reducing fatigue.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Caffeine may boost metabolic rate and aid calorie burning.

items.title: Calcium from milk
items.content: The milk component provides calcium, essential for bones and teeth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Coffee supplies small amounts of B2, B3, and B5 vitamins involved in energy metabolism.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat after caffeine.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Flavored lattes often contain added sugar, increasing their calorie count.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance should choose dairy‑free alternatives or use plant‑based milks.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee can raise stomach acidity, causing heartburn in susceptible individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: To prepare a latte, combine one shot of espresso with hot milk in a 1:3 ratio, add the chosen flavoring and, if desired, a sweetener. It is best enjoyed within 30‑60 minutes of preparation while the aroma and temperature are optimal.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Prepared flavored latte should be refrigerated and consumed within 24 hours. Prolonged storage can diminish flavor intensity and milk freshness. Gently reheat before drinking, but avoid boiling.
